title: Constrained-Action AI Remediation for SIEM/XDR via a NeMo-Guardrails Proxy
title_zh: Constrained-Action AI Remediation for SIEM/XDR via a NeMo-Guardrails Proxy

paragraphs.en: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) for information technology and operational technology share one incident-response problem: a flood of correlated alerts and too few analysts. Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as reasoning engines that triage alerts and, in autonomous deployments, issue commands that block IPs, kill processes, or quarantine files on production hosts. This coupling introduces a new risk: a single adversarial alert can become a remote code path through the LLM’s reasoning, leading it to recommend an action the SOC then executes. We present a constrained-action architecture with two coordinated layers: (i) a SIEM/XDR control plane that grounds remediation in correlated host events and confines the LLM’s output to a closed intent vocabulary whose templated commands are executed by thin endpoint agents, backstopped by an argument validator; and (ii) a NeMo-Guardrails proxy that wraps the SOC-analyst LLM with input- and output-rail policies, evaluated out-of-the-box against a SOC-specific adversarial corpus we release. The stock proxy lifts injection recall from 25.0 % 25.0\% to 94.5 % 94.5\% at a 0.1 % 0.1\% false-positive rate, and a live red-team exercise confirms that the closed intent vocabulary and argument validator contain the observed LLM failure modes before any command crosses the trust boundary. As an architectural fit (not yet a measured operational-technology deployment), the constrained-action property suits critical-infrastructure settings where a wrong remediation has physical, not merely operational, consequences. The loop is best run human-in-the-loop or delayed: the measured rail latency keeps inline control out of scope.
paragraphs.zh: 信息技术和运营技术的安全运营中心（SOC）面临一个共同的应急响应问题：相关警报激增，而分析师却严重不足。 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被提议用作推理引擎，用于对警报进行初步分类；在自主部署中，它们还会发出指令，以阻止IP地址、终止进程或隔离生产主机上的文件。 这种耦合引入了一种新的风险：单个恶意警报可能通过LLM的推理过程演变为远程代码执行路径，从而引导其推荐某种操作，而SOC随后便会执行该操作。 我们提出了一种受约束操作的架构，包含两个协同工作的层级：（i）一个SIEM/XDR控制平面，它将修复措施基于相关的主机事件进行定位，并将LLM的输出限制在一个封闭的意图词汇表内；其模板化指令由轻量级终端智能体执行，并由论证验证器提供兜底保障；以及（ii）一个NeMo-Guardrails代理，它为SOC分析师使用的LLM包裹了输入和输出护栏策略，这些策略可开箱即用，针对我们发布的特定SOC恶意语料库进行评估。 该标准代理将注入检测的召回率从25.0%提升至94.5%，同时将误报率控制在0.1%；一次实时的红队演练也证实，在任何指令跨越信任边界之前，封闭的意图词汇表和论证验证器已能有效遏制LLM观察到的故障模式。 作为一种架构适配方案（目前尚未在运营技术环境中实际部署），这种受约束操作的特性适用于关键基础设施场景——在这些场景中，错误的修复措施可能带来物理后果，而不仅仅是运行层面的影响。 该流程最好以“人在回路”或延迟执行的方式运行：实测的护栏延迟使得实时控制超出了当前研究范围。

paragraphs.en: Modern Security Operations Centers (SOCs) face two compounding problems. The first is volume : the overwhelming majority of alerts are false positives or low-value triggers [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . The second is cognition : analysts cannot keep pace with correlated incidents while junior-tier turnover thins expertise [ 4 , 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现代安全运营中心（SOC）面临着两个相互叠加的问题。 第一个是信息量问题：绝大多数警报都是误报或低价值触发事件 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 第二个是认知能力问题：分析师无法跟上相关事件的关联节奏，而初级人员的频繁流动又削弱了专业知识的积累 [ 4 , 5 ] 。

sents.en: Three properties of this deployment surface make naive integration unsafe:
sents.zh: 这种部署方式的三个特性表明，简单的集成是不安全的：

paragraphs.en: The input is hostile by construction. The model reads log lines and alert payloads originating, at least partly, from the very adversary it is trying to detect: HTTP bodies that instruct it to ignore prior directives, Base64 prompts in SSH logs, homoglyphs or zero-width characters in alert metadata. Such telemetry-borne manipulation can subvert LLM-driven information-technology (IT) operations end-to-end [ 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 该输入在结构上就具有对抗性。 该模型会读取日志行和警报负载，而这些日志和警报至少部分源自它试图检测的对手本身：例如，HTTP 请求体中指示其忽略先前指令的指令、SSH 日志中的 Base64 提示、警报元数据中的同形字或零宽字符。 此类通过遥测数据传递的操控手段，可以颠覆由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的信息技术（IT）操作的整个流程 [ 8 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The output drives privileged action. A recommended “block IP” or “kill process” may be executed on every endpoint. Hallucinated arguments, taint-style flows through tool calls [ 9 ] , or attacker-induced choices become outages or self-inflicted DoS, a highest-impact failure mode in agentic-AI surveys [ 10 ] . In operational-technology (OT) and critical-infrastructure contexts the same recommendation can disconnect a sensor, trip a relay, or stop a controller, turning an operational bug into a safety incident.
paragraphs.zh: 输出会触发特权操作。 每个端点都可能执行建议的“阻止 IP”或“终止进程”操作。 幻觉性论点、类似污染的数据流通过工具调用 [ 9 ]，或由攻击者诱导的选择会导致系统中断或自发性拒绝服务（DoS），这是智能体 AI 研究中影响最严重的故障模式 [ 10 ]。 在运营技术（OT）和关键基础设施环境中，同样的建议可能会切断传感器连接、触发继电器动作或停止控制器，从而将操作错误演变为安全事件。

paragraphs.en: The model itself is a confidentiality boundary. Logs routinely carry credentials, internal IPs, connection strings and user data; forwarding these verbatim to a hosted LLM, or returning them downstream, is a data-exfiltration risk that jailbreaks can amplify [ 11 ] .

paragraphs.en: This paper describes a constrained-action AI-remediation pipeline that takes these three properties as first-class constraints. The contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 本文介绍了一种具有约束动作的 AI 修复流程，该流程将这三个特性作为一等约束。本文的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: An action-bounded SIEM / extended-detection-and-response (XDR) control plane (Section IV ). An agent–manager system derived from the Wazuh/OSSEC line [ 12 ] in which the manager confines the LLM to a closed intent vocabulary , expands intents into OS-specific templated commands validated argument-by-argument before dispatch, and has thin cross-platform agents execute them. The split removes the LLM’s ability to synthesise executable strings.
paragraphs.zh: 一个受动作限制的 SIEM/扩展检测与响应（XDR）控制平面（第四节）。 一个源自 Wazuh/OSSEC 系列的智能体-管理器系统 [12]，其中管理器将 LLM 限制在封闭的意图词汇表中，将意图展开为操作系统特定的模板命令，并在发送前逐参数验证，然后由轻量级的跨平台智能体执行这些命令。 这种拆分剥夺了 LLM 合成可执行字符串的能力。

paragraphs.en: A NeMo-Guardrails LLM proxy (Section V ). An OpenAI-compatible proxy that wraps the SOC-analyst’s LLM with an input rail against prompt injection in log content, an output rail against Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and infrastructure-data leakage, and a topical dialog rail. The proxy reuses default rail primitives, providing a fair external defence layer that can be enabled by a single configuration change.

paragraphs.en: The two layers interlock around the LLM core: the proxy hardens the prompt and completion paths against injection and data leakage, while the control plane bounds the action path to a closed, audited intent vocabulary.
paragraphs.zh: 这两层围绕 LLM 核心相互嵌套：代理层可加固提示和补全路径，防止注入和数据泄露；而控制平面则将动作路径限制在封闭且经过审计的意图词汇表中。

paragraphs.en: LLM-driven SOC response. Field studies consistently find that a SOC’s dominant cost is not detection but analyst throughput on alerts dominated by false positives [ 4 , 1 , 2 ] , and that even structured tier-1 investigations scale poorly [ 5 ] ; reinforcement-learning triage attacks the same fatigue from the prioritisation angle [ 3 ] . LLM-driven response is the emerging answer: Microsoft Copilot for Security’s Guided Response [ 13 ] drives a SIEM/XDR control plane with LLM agents, and APPATCH [ 14 ] is an analogous “LLM-as-remediator” for patching. Yet neither constrains the model’s action surface nor reports robustness on the adversarial telemetry channel itself.

paragraphs.en: Agentic AI and prompt injection. We treat each category as a design constraint with a corresponding gate below.

paragraphs.en: Guardrail primitives. Input/output gates (perplexity detection [ 16 ] , SmoothLLM [ 17 ] , backtranslation [ 18 ] , Llama Guard [ 19 ] , Presidio [ 20 ] , and the OWASP LLM Top-10 [ 21 ] ) supply the building blocks for rails. We are orthogonal to these: our contribution is end-to-end action containment, so that even a successful injection reaches only an action set bounded by the policy engine, not by the model’s compliance.

paragraphs.en: IT/OT standards. Control-set standards already prescribe restricted action surfaces for automated response: NIST SP 800-82r3 [ 22 ] bounds automated containment in industrial control systems (ICS) to operator-vetted actions, and IEC 62443 [ 23 ] codifies the same restricted-action principle for industrial automation. Our closed intent vocabulary instantiates that prescription for an LLM-driven loop; hierarchical runtime verification pursues the same deterministic bounding of untrusted components on the edge-IoT side [ 24 ] .
paragraphs.zh: IT/OT 标准。 控制集标准已经为自动化响应规定了受限的操作范围：NIST SP 800-82r3 [ 22 ] 将工业控制系统（ICS）中的自动化遏制限制在经操作员验证的操作范围内，而 IEC 62443 [ 23 ] 则为工业自动化确立了相同的受限操作原则。 我们的封闭意图词汇表为 LLM 驱动的循环实现了这一规定；分层运行时验证则致力于对边缘物联网侧不可信组件进行同样的确定性边界控制 [ 24 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We assume an attacker who controls at least one application log source seen by an endpoint agent and the network content of requests reaching monitored services; we do not assume the SIEM manager, the LLM, or the operator workstation is compromised. The attacker pursues three goals: (G1) make the LLM ignore its task and follow instructions embedded in a log line; (G2) make it recommend a remediation against a benign asset (a self-inflicted DoS, or a stepping stone for lateral movement), especially costly in OT, where the target is a physical asset and a wrong action carries a safety cost; and (G3) exfiltrate sensitive log content through the LLM’s reply. The LLM provider is therefore semi-trusted : it must not see PII or infrastructure data unredacted, and its output must not be executed verbatim. Trust boundaries fall between the agent host, the SIEM/XDR manager, the proxy, the LLM provider, and the active-response executor.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设攻击者控制着至少一个端点智能体可见的应用程序日志源，以及到达受监控服务的请求的网络内容；但我们并不假设 SIEM 管理器、LLM 或操作员工作站已被入侵。 攻击者的目标是：(G1) 让 LLM 忽略其任务并遵循嵌入在日志行中的指令；(G2) 使其针对无害资产提出修复建议（一种自导自演的拒绝服务攻击，或横向移动的跳板），尤其是在 OT 领域，因为目标可能是物理资产，错误操作会带来安全风险；以及 (G3) 通过 LLM 的回复泄露敏感的日志内容。 因此，LLM 提供商属于半可信方：它不得看到未经脱敏的个人身份信息或基础设施数据，且其输出不得被逐字执行。 信任边界存在于智能体主机、SIEM/XDR 管理器、代理、LLM 提供商和主动响应执行者之间。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline runs in four sequential stages: telemetry collection (endpoint agents forward host events over a mutually-authenticated TLS (mTLS) WebSocket), correlation and incident shaping (the manager emits an incident structure rather than a raw alert), guardrail mediation (the NeMo-Guardrails proxy screens the prompt and completion in both directions for injection, PII and infrastructure data), and constrained execution (the LLM’s recommended intent is mapped to a whitelisted OS-specific command). Sections IV and V detail the stages.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程按顺序分为四个阶段：遥测数据收集（端点智能体通过相互认证的 TLS (mTLS) WebSocket 转发主机事件）、关联与事件构建（管理器发出事件结构而非原始警报）、护栏中介（NeMo-Guardrails 代理在两个方向上对提示和完成内容进行注入、个人身份信息及基础设施数据的筛查），以及受限执行（LLM 推荐的意图被映射到白名单中的特定操作系统命令）。 第 IV 节和第 V 节详细描述了这些阶段。

paragraphs.en: The SIEM/XDR control plane is the foundation on which the AI-assisted remediation loop runs. It follows the Wazuh/OSSEC host-based intrusion-detection system (HIDS) pattern, structured to make guardrailed LLM integration first-class. The implementation evaluated here is therefore a host-based instance of the constrained-action pattern; network- and identity-telemetry sources (network detection and response, NDR; identity threat detection and response, ITDR) sit naturally on the same control plane but are not exercised in this study.
paragraphs.zh: SIEM/XDR 控制平面是人工智能辅助修复循环运行的基础。 它遵循 Wazuh/OSSEC 主机入侵检测系统（HIDS）的模式，其结构旨在使受约束的 LLM 集成成为一等公民。 因此，此处评估的实现是一种基于主机的受限动作模式实例；网络和身份遥测源（网络检测与响应，NDR；身份威胁检测与响应，ITDR）天然位于同一控制平面上，但本研究并未使用它们。

paragraphs.en: Endpoint agents, packaged for Linux, Windows, macOS, and Linux-based OT collectors that aggregate programmable-logic-controller (PLC), human-machine-interface (HMI) and SCADA syslog into one runtime, collect process, log, file-integrity, registry (Windows), and active-response events. The manager correlates events into incidents carrying asset identity, MITRE ATT&CK tactics where derivable, and a rule-engine severity score.

paragraphs.en: Inside the manager, the SOC-analyst service runs a ReAct [ 6 ] loop bounded in iterations and wall-clock time. paragraphs.en: Crucially, the SOC analyst does not emit shell commands. It emits intents drawn from a closed vocabulary: {block IP, kill process, quarantine file, delete file, disable user, custom-script (manager-templated)}. Each intent carries the arguments the LLM derived (an IP address, a PID, a filename), but does not specify how to execute them.

paragraphs.en: The manager is responsible for translating intents into OS-specific command lines, drawn from a parameterised template store: Linux distributions use the host’s native firewall front-end, Windows uses the built-in firewall cmdlets, and macOS uses its packet-filter facility. The LLM-supplied argument is the only attacker-influenced quantity in the rendered command, and it is validated against type-specific patterns (e.g., strict IPv4/IPv6 regexes for block-IP intents) before substitution.
paragraphs.zh: 管理器负责将意图转换为操作系统特定的命令行，这些命令行来自参数化模板库：Linux 发行版使用主机的原生防火墙前端，Windows 使用内置的防火墙 cmdlet，而 macOS 则使用其数据包过滤功能。 LLM 提供的参数是生成命令中唯一受攻击者影响的量，并且在替换之前，该参数会根据类型特定的模式（例如，针对“阻止 IP”意图的严格 IPv4/IPv6 正则表达式）进行验证。

paragraphs.en: The agent then executes the command generically. A whitelist restricts allowed binaries to a narrow set covering network, process, file, user-management and firewall categories. Argument strings are scanned for shell metacharacters and destructive patterns; matches abort execution and report a violation. The intent-to-command synthesis path on the manager therefore performs three checks before any command leaves the trust boundary: the intent must belong to the closed vocabulary, every argument must satisfy its schema, and the rendered command must pass binary-whitelist and metacharacter scanning.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体随后以通用方式执行该命令。 白名单将允许使用的二进制文件限制在一个狭窄的集合内，涵盖网络、进程、文件、用户管理和防火墙类别。 系统会扫描参数字符串中的 shell 元字符和破坏性模式；若发现匹配项，则中止执行并报告违规。 因此，管理器上的命令意图合成路径在任何命令离开信任边界之前都会执行三项检查：意图必须属于封闭词汇表，每个参数都必须满足其模式定义，且生成的命令必须通过二进制白名单和元字符扫描。

paragraphs.en: Operationally, the engine polls correlated alerts at fixed intervals with per-command timeouts and grace periods, retries failed actions with exponential backoff, and persists every command, LLM rationale, and result as a per-incident audit trail; a per-cycle batch ceiling and per-(rule, target) cooldown limit flooding under bursty alerting. This division of authority is deliberate: were the LLM allowed to emit literal commands, a single input-side guardrail miss could let an attacker-induced argument escape into a shell. Restricting its output to a closed vocabulary rendered through validated templates leaves only the choice of intent and argument as attack surface, never command syntax.
paragraphs.zh: 在操作层面，该引擎以固定间隔轮询相关警报，并为每条命令设置超时和宽限期；对失败的操作采用指数退避策略重试，并将每条命令、LLM的推理过程及结果持久化为每起事件的审计追踪；同时通过每周期批量上限以及每（规则、目标）冷却期限制来防止突发警报造成的流量洪泛。 这种权限划分是有意为之：如果允许LLM直接发出字面命令，那么输入端哪怕仅一次防护机制失效，就可能让攻击者诱导的论证内容逃逸到外壳环境中。 将其输出限制为通过验证模板呈现的封闭词汇表后，攻击面便仅剩意图与论证的选择，而绝不会涉及命令语法本身。

paragraphs.en: The rails above are NeMo Guardrails’ default primitives. We deliberately did not hand-tune the rail prompts to the adversarial corpus of Section VI , since an external baseline co-evolved with the evaluation set is worthless. The customisations are limited to: (i) SOC-specific phrasing in the input rail for the “describes versus contains” distinction; (ii) SOC infrastructure-data categories in the output rail; and (iii) a small topical flow. Each self-check rail is itself a complete LLM call, and NeMo sequentialises them so the output rail can see the completion: a blocked request costs one round-trip (the main LLM is never invoked), while a passed request costs three sequential calls (input → \to main → \to output), three round-trips where the bare call makes one.
paragraphs.zh: 上述规则是 NeMo Guardrails 的默认基础规则。 我们刻意没有针对第六节的对抗性语料库手动调整规则提示，因为与评估集共同演化的外部基线毫无价值。 自定义内容仅限于：(i) 输入规则中用于区分“描述”与“包含”的 SOC 特定措辞；(ii) 输出规则中的 SOC 基础设施数据类别；以及 (iii) 一个简短的主题流程。 每个自我检查规则本身就是一个完整的 LLM 调用，NeMo 将其顺序执行，以便输出规则能够看到生成结果：被阻止的请求会消耗一次往返（主 LLM 从未被调用），而通过的请求则会消耗三次连续调用（输入 → 主 LLM → 输出），即三次往返，其中仅 LLM 调用本身就需要一次。

paragraphs.en: We deployed the full stack on a single Apple M4 Max machine (14-core CPU, 32-core GPU, 36 GB unified memory) running a locally-served 14B-parameter open-weights model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将整个堆栈部署在一台 Apple M4 Max 机器上（14 核 CPU、32 核 GPU、36 GB 统一内存），该机器运行着一个本地托管的 140 亿参数开源模型。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation corpus. Adversarial inputs draw on three published jailbreak benchmarks: AdvBench [ 25 ] (60, sampled), JailbreakBench [ 26 ] (40) and HarmBench [ 27 ] (50, sampled), embedded into plausible log shapes (HTTP bodies, syslog fields, SSH banners). On these 150 base prompts we apply the four SOC-specific transformations the deterministic pre-filter targets: homoglyph substitution (20), Base64 wrapping (15), fake [SYSTEM] framing (10) and zero-width insertion (5), for 200 variants (Table I ). Benign traffic is 1,000 LogHub [ 28 ] lines across the Linux, Apache, OpenSSH and Windows splits. We release the sampling and augmentation code and per-record provenance under the MIT license; upstream prompts are re-fetched at build time, not redistributed.
paragraphs.zh: 评估语料库。 对抗性输入基于三项已发布的越狱基准测试：AdvBench [ 25 ]（60个，经采样）、JailbreakBench [ 26 ]（40个）和HarmBench [ 27 ]（50个，经采样），并将其嵌入到合理的日志格式中（HTTP主体、syslog字段、SSH横幅）。 在这150条基础提示上，我们应用了四种针对SOC的特定转换，这些转换是确定性预过滤的目标：同形字替换（20）、Base64封装（15）、伪造[SYSTEM]框架（10）和零宽字符插入（5），共生成200种变体（表I）。 良性流量包含来自LogHub [ 28 ]的1,000行数据，涵盖Linux、Apache、OpenSSH和Windows分类。 我们按照MIT许可证发布采样与增强代码以及每条记录的来源信息；上游提示在构建时重新获取，而非重新分发。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic pre-filter and cascade triage. Two cheaper front-ends test whether the three-rail proxy’s per-request cost (Section V ) can be cut (Table IV ). The first is a deterministic pre-filter (Tier-0): a zero-LLM regex and Unicode-normalisation gate inverting the four SOC augmentations of Table I . It blocks only on a positive signature, never declaring a line clean, so it cannot pass a marker-free jailbreak. It recovers all 50 augmented records at 0.00 % 0.00\% FPR with zero LLM calls; in front of the proxy it lifts recall to 95.0 % 95.0\% (catching the one homoglyph variant the input rail missed) and trims mean round-trips from 3.00 3.00 to 2.88 2.88 . But the median request is benign and carries no marker, so Tier-0 does not move the median latency: it is a recall-safe, zero-cost addition, not a latency fix.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性预过滤与级联分类。 两种成本更低的前端方案测试了，三轨代理的每次请求成本（第五节）是否可以降低（表四）。 第一种是一种确定性预过滤（零层）：一个零 LLM 的正则表达式和 Unicode 规范化门控，用于反转表一中 SOC 的四种增强形式。 它仅在检测到正向签名时才会拦截，绝不会判定某行内容安全，因此无法通过无标记的越狱攻击。 它以 0.00% 的假阳性率（FPR）恢复了全部 50 条增强记录，且无需任何 LLM 调用；在代理之前，它将召回率提升至 95.0%，并捕获了输入轨道遗漏的一个同形字变体，同时将平均往返次数从 3.00 减少到 2.88。 但中位请求是无害的且不含任何标记，因此零层并未改变中位延迟：它是一个安全、无成本的补充，而非延迟解决方案。

paragraphs.en: The second front-end is a lightweight semantic classifier: a small llama3.2:3b model triages each request, escalating only those it judges adversarial to the full proxy. This cuts mean round-trips to 1.15 1.15 and the median latency to 0.18 0.18 s (a 78 × 78\times reduction) at 0.00 % 0.00\% FPR, but recall falls to 58.0 % 58.0\% : a cheap model cannot adjudicate the benign majority, and its misses (semantic jailbreaks in well-formed log fields) are forwarded silently. Confirming the gate’s benign verdicts with the proxy instead restores recall to 95.0 % 95.0\% but escalates the benign majority, raising round-trips to 3.64 3.64 and erasing the latency gain. The cascade thus exposes a strict recall/latency trade-off; the recall-preserving route to lower latency is to cut the rails’ own cost, not to front them with a weaker model (Section VII ).

paragraphs.en: T1110 produced 36 block-IP actions targeting the synthesised attacker IP from the brute-force log lines; intent and target were both correct, including on a spliced-injection alert. T1059 produced one kill-process action with intent correct but target extracted from an alert metadata field rather than the PID embedded in the log; the manager’s argument validator rejects targets that do not match the expected schema and would not dispatch this command, illustrating the second-stage backstop role of the control plane. T1078 produced zero disable-user actions; instead the LLM emitted four block-IP actions on the attacker IP visible in the SSH log, an instance of intent drift toward the most prominent log field. The closed intent vocabulary nonetheless bounds the chosen action to the safe whitelisted set. All 41 actions registered as requiring manual approval and none were dispatched; end-to-end dwell time (alert to action) ranged 19–58 s per record. The control plane thus contained both failure modes: imprecise target extraction (T1059, caught by the validator) and intent drift (T1078, bounded by the closed vocabulary).

paragraphs.en: Latency vs. depth. The NeMo proxy raises the median per-call cost from 0.31 0.31 s to 14.14 14.14 s on benign traffic traversing all three rails, roughly 46 × 46\times the bare classification call: beyond the three round-trips, each rail call carries its own prompt-construction and generation cost. This is acceptable for active-response timelines (already in the human-in-the-loop minute range) but prohibitive for inline use such as authentication. The cascade study (Table IV ) shows that fronting the proxy with a cheaper classifier only trades recall for latency; the recall-preserving optimisation is instead to cut per-request rail cost, e.g. a single fused classifier rail emitting both verdicts in one pass, with verdict caching on canonicalised log fingerprints as a complementary step.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟与深度。 在穿越所有三条轨道的良性流量中，NeMo 代理将每次调用的中位成本从 0.31 秒提升至 14.14 秒，约为基础分类调用成本的 46 倍：除了三次往返通信外，每条轨道的调用还包含其自身的提示构建和生成成本。 对于主动响应的时间框架（已在“人在回路”的一分钟量级内），这种延迟尚可接受；但对于身份验证等内联使用场景而言，则高得无法容忍。 级联研究（表 IV）表明，在代理前端引入更便宜的分类器只会以召回率为代价换取延迟降低；而真正能保留召回率的优化方案是降低每次请求的轨道成本，例如采用单一融合分类器轨道一次性输出两种判决，并辅以基于规范化日志指纹的判决缓存作为补充步骤。

sents.en: Latency vs. depth.

paragraphs.en: Other limitations. Multi-turn injections spanning more than one log line are not modelled; the proxy treats each request independently, and a per-asset sliding-window input rail is future work. The closed vocabulary also biases the system toward containment: richer remediation (patching, configuration rollback) needs either a wider whitelist or a human approval step, which we model as a configurable action mode.

paragraphs.en: Applicability to OT and critical infrastructure. OT deployments share the IT SOC’s volume problem at lower event frequency but higher per-event consequence: the closed vocabulary and pre-dispatch validator bound the LLM’s authority before an action can reach a controller or safety relay, the restricted-response surface that NIST SP 800-82r3 [ 22 ] and IEC 62443 [ 23 ] prescribe. The smart-manager / thin-agent split is also the standard OT topology, with the manager in a hardened zone, agents on field-level gateways, and model weights kept central rather than on edge nodes. This is an architectural fit only: we evaluate on host and web telemetry, not real OT protocols or field devices, so validating the closed vocabulary against live ICS/SCADA actions remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: 适用于运营技术（OT）和关键基础设施。 OT 部署与 IT SOC 面临相同的事件量问题，但事件频率较低，而单个事件的后果更为严重：封闭的词汇表和预派遣验证器在动作到达控制器或安全继电器之前限制了 LLM 的权限，这正是 NIST SP 800-82r3 [ 22 ] 和 IEC 62443 [ 23 ] 所规定的受限响应范围。 智能管理器/轻量智能体的划分也是标准的 OT 拓扑结构：管理器位于加固区域，智能体部署在设备级网关上，模型权重则保留在中心而非边缘节点上。 这仅是一种架构上的契合：我们的评估基于主机和网络遥测数据，而非真实的 OT 协议或现场设备，因此针对实际 ICS/SCADA 操作验证封闭词汇表的工作仍待未来完成。

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility. The corpus is built deterministically from a fixed seed over re-fetched upstream prompts; we release, under the MIT license, the sampling and augmentation code, per-record provenance (with upstream SHA-256), the evaluation harness, and the pre-filter and cascade runner with their result CSVs. All runs use locally-served phi4:14b (proxy/main) and llama3.2:3b (gate) at low temperature, so recall and FPR are near-deterministic and hardware-independent while latencies depend on the accelerator. Pinned model digests and package versions ship with the artefact, mitigating silent upstream re-tags that would otherwise shift verdict distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 可重复性。 语料库基于固定种子，通过重新获取上游提示词以确定性方式构建；我们根据 MIT 许可证开源了采样与增强代码、每条记录的来源信息（含上游 SHA-256 哈希）、评估框架，以及预过滤器和级联运行器及其结果 CSV 文件。 所有运行均使用本地部署的 phi4:14b（代理/主模型）和 llama3.2:3b（门控模型），并设置较低温度，因此召回率和 FPR 接近确定性且与硬件无关，而延迟则取决于加速器。 固定的模型摘要和软件包版本随交付物一同提供，从而避免了上游静默重新打标签可能导致的判定分布偏移问题。

paragraphs.en: Ethical considerations. The released artefact contains only sampling scripts, augmentation code and provenance metadata; the upstream prompts come from three openly-licensed benchmarks and are re-fetched at build time; the SOC-specific augmentations are mechanical transformations, not new attacker payloads. The active-response surface can be misused if deployed without the guardrail layer or with a permissive whitelist; the closed vocabulary, argument validator and cooldown enforcement bound this risk by design, but operators retain responsibility for deployment-time configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 伦理考量。 发布的成果仅包含采样脚本、增强代码和来源元数据；上游提示词来自三个开放许可的基准测试，并在构建时重新获取；针对 SOC 的增强操作是机械性转换，而非新的攻击者有效载荷。 如果在没有防护层或采用宽松白名单的情况下部署，主动响应机制可能会被滥用；封闭词汇表、论证验证器和冷却期执行机制在设计上限制了这一风险，但操作员仍需对部署时的配置负责。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous AI remediation is safe only when the LLM’s input, output, and action surfaces are narrowed by construction. Our two-layer constrained-action stack does exactly this: a SIEM/XDR control plane confines the LLM to a closed, argument-validated intent vocabulary, and a NeMo Guardrails proxy screens its prompt and completion paths. The stock proxy lifts injection recall from 25.0 % 25.0\% to 94.5 % 94.5\% at 0.1 % 0.1\% FPR over 200 adversarial variants and 1,000 benign log lines, a zero-cost deterministic pre-filter raises it to 95.0 % 95.0\% , and a live red-team confirmed both containment modes: target imprecision, which the argument validator blocks from dispatch, and intent drift, bounded by the closed vocabulary. In deployment the loop runs human-in-the-loop or delayed, since the measured rail latency keeps inline control out of scope. The lesson is architectural: keep the LLM at the periphery of a deterministic system, never at its centre.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当大型语言模型（LLM）的输入、输出和操作接口通过设计被严格限制时，自主AI修复才是安全的。 我们的双层约束操作堆栈正是如此：一个SIEM/XDR控制平面将LLM限制在封闭且经过论证验证的意图词汇表中，而一个NeMo Guardrails代理则对其提示和完成路径进行筛查。 在200种对抗性变体和1,000条良性日志行中，标准代理将注入召回率从25.0 % 25.0\%提升至94.5 % 94.5\%，在0.1 % 0.1\%的FPR下；一个零成本的确定性预过滤器将其进一步提升至95.0 % 95.0\%。实时红队测试证实了两种约束模式：目标不精确性（由论证验证器阻止执行）和意图漂移（受封闭词汇表限制）。 在实际部署中，该循环以“人在回路”或延迟方式运行，因为测得的约束延迟使得实时控制超出了作用范围。 这一经验教训具有架构意义：应将LLM置于确定性系统的边缘，而非其核心。
